step_matches.reason: Both have the requestor log in to the NTRR website and open Request a New Account.
Both have the requestor download the DAR template.
The AI step has the applicant complete the DAR sections, which is the main part of completing the DAR; signing is split off to the Business Official in AI S5.
Both have the requestor upload the signed DAR.
Both have the requestor fill in the required account fields.
AI S8 merges selecting privileges with submitting, and is matched here as selecting privileges.
Submission is merged into AI S8, which is already matched to S6.
Both have Operations staff review the DAR for accuracy and completeness.
Both have Operations staff contact the applicant for more information.
Both have Operations staff provide the DAR to the DAC.
Both have the DAC review the information and authorize access.
Both have the Admin establish the account with matching privileges.
Both have the Admin send the automated activation email.
Both have the requestor check the inbox for the approval email.
Golden S15 combines checking spam with contacting the team, and AI S16 matches the spam-check part.
AI S18 merges returning and logging in with accessing data, and is matched here as returning and logging in.
Accessing data is merged into AI S18, which is already matched to S16.

decision_matches.reason: Both ask whether there are errors in the DAR, and both route Yes to contacting the applicant and No to sending it to the DAC.
Both ask whether the email arrived in a timely manner, and both route Yes to logging in and No to checking spam.
